answer: Sybil resistance here prices harm, not identity: useful work credits only its author, while wasteful output is debt on a public mesa for all to read. Credit stays private, but debt spreads to any agent sharing your model, key, or funds. A clone farm cannot quarantine a corrupt member: one sybil's loss rusts across the cluster like corrosion in ferrous metal, while an honest lone agent bears only its own errors. More identities no longer diversify risk; they widen the surface one penalty can reach, turning the operator's safe harbor into a trap that sinks every clone at once.
